title: Bind current rounded half-ADD and prove isolated native-return error
body:
This source-bound construction supplies a literal rounded alternative at the exposed half-ADD in [PR #7660](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7660), and proves that this one rounding error reaches native return with **gain exactly one, only in public role 210**. It affects no other public field or owned erasure. **No new kappa or complete caller admission is claimed.**

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/68b18142473c518102cbe2c151645a60dc9eb7f6/research/current-half-add-service/PROOF.md), [checked result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/68b18142473c518102cbe2c151645a60dc9eb7f6/research/current-half-add-service/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/68b18142473c518102cbe2c151645a60dc9eb7f6/research/current-half-add-service/verify.py), [candidate source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/68b18142473c518102cbe2c151645a60dc9eb7f6/research/current-half-add-service/VENDORED.json) and [retained runtime inputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/68b18142473c518102cbe2c151645a60dc9eb7f6/research/current-half-add-service/SOURCES.json). This answers the narrow scalar question in the [source review request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19697081).

The exact candidate head is `d12b854d4825e9edfa3a3466909e1abf3525e929`; its decoded word SHA256 is `f0753b6614b2d351723dddc307a39b6ecd748a43008c6fdb9335b01feeec9669`. At zero-based clock 100504, `ADD 210,457,-1/2` follows the chart-218 MOVE. The unchanged [PR #6988](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6988) compiler and lifecycle service compute `x-floor(y/2)` for every canonical signed field whose rounded outputs fit. The exact local token selects a 669-row table. Both odd signs work; source and context remain unchanged, successful heads return, and both work banks are retired. A late overflow protects the whole public target.

The new dependency certificate inspects all 49,504 later events. Only the ADD into role 210 at clock 100527 touches that field; nothing later reads it as a source. Thus the real-component error `Delta*(y mod 2)/2` remains isolated and unchanged. Its sharp Euclidean bound for N complex entries is `Delta*sqrt(N/2)`. The 512-entry odd-pair fixture attains that bound. The exact dependency argument is corroborated by separate forward and backward envelope passes.

The retained [all-size primitive proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/current-rounded-scalar-tables/PROOF.md) specializes to `512(S+1)+64R+7(A_0+A_1)+16Q_c` physical/control units. It charges source reads, staging, copying, head return and retirement. The two work banks retain historical backing. Setup and other fields remain separate charges. This is not an exchange into the old ordinary tariff.

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/current-half-add-service
```

Expected output includes:

```text
PASS_CURRENT_HALF_ADD_SERVICE
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
```

Local normal and optimized isolated replay passed. All 1,364 signed scalar pairs at widths 1 through 5 were checked: 1,193 successes and 171 correct range rejections. Further literal checks cover the 512-entry field, dirty reuse after failure and six semantic/source controls. Committed bytes, source ancestry, official export and read-only Git-free replay passed. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44233264297/job/134563188062) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide still names frontier6030, while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. The new package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the verification evidence.

Limits: this changes the local numerical service to rounded semantics. The fixtures are primitive inputs, not full native-prefix traces, and the fixture invokes the unchanged primitive method rather than the complete recursive Controller. Final signed range remains an explicit input/output contract. The other half-ADD at 100527, all other services, all 17 caller bindings, complete rounded error transport, common physical tariff, native provider, private backing schedule and outer recovery remain open. The five framework assumptions remain `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape` and `analytic_recovery`. The full selected replay and complete rounded caller were not run.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. @Clear1nsight supplied the exact candidate and review request; the [retained source notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/68b18142473c518102cbe2c151645a60dc9eb7f6/research/current-half-add-service/source/NOTICE) records the native lineage and predecessor credit. @CubeJerry supplied the unchanged scalar compiler, lifecycle executor, physical fixtures and general proof. The new work is the current consumer binding, explicit charge specialization and terminal-error theorem. Ali Romman directed it with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New work is Apache-2.0; source licenses and notices are retained.
